name: Amir Hossain Amu
contribution: Amir Hossain Amu was an Awami League politician who participated in the movement against Ershad from the 1980s through 1990 and later held parliamentary and ministerial office.
context: His political work formed part of the opposition networks that challenged military-backed rule and sought a return to parliamentary democracy. Government biographical material also records his earlier involvement in the 1969 movement and the Liberation War.
impact: Amu's career connects the 1990 mass uprising to the longer organizational history of Awami League opposition politics and shows how movement leaders later entered formal government.
